activity.title: Deutsch Party Brett
activity.summary: Älteres, eigenständiges Grundschul-Lernspiel mit Setup-, Brett-, Minigame- und Ergebnisfluss sowie einem zentralen Register vieler deutscher Sprach-Minispiele.
reusableContracts: standard minigame interface: id, name_de, topics, setup(container, task, onComplete)
task generator separated from minigame renderer
screen manager for start, setup, board, minigame and results
prohibitedIntegration: directly importing the complete legacy application into the documentation core
treating points, accuracy or game completion as competency proof
copying learner profiles or progress scores into child documentation
automatically assigning a game from a presumed child trait
requiredBeforeAcceptance: browser runtime test on current target devices
rights review for all images, sounds and fonts
mapping of each mechanic to an explicit optional learning operation
adapter that emits bounded activity and effect events instead of scores as truth
